pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A child says, "I am better than others because I am unique." What is wrong with this idea? (1 mark)
   A. Uniqueness has no meaning
   B. Nobody is unique
   C. Only rich children are unique
   D. Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it

2. Which of these can help a child who is sad? (1 mark)
   A. Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   B. Hiding alone for days
   C. Being rude to others
   D. Refusing to eat

3. Which action shows respect for a grandmother? (1 mark)
   A. Helping her to carry water
   B. Laughing at her
   C. Shouting at her
   D. Ignoring her greeting

4. In a family tree, where are the grandparents normally placed? (1 mark)
   A. At the bottom
   B. Outside the tree
   C. In the middle with the children
   D. At the top

5. What is one warning sign that a situation is unsafe? (1 mark)
   A. You feel sleepy
   B. You feel proud
   C. You feel happy
   D. You feel uneasy or scared

6. Why should Christians respect their bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Because of money
   B. Because they are proud
   C. The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   D. Because it is fashionable

7. What does "holy" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Old
   B. Fast
   C. Pure, perfect and set apart
   D. Rich

8. Which of these is the correct way to handle the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Sit on it
   B. Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   C. Drop it on the floor
   D. Draw on its pages

9. Which of these is a Gospel? (1 mark)
   A. John
   B. Acts
   C. Psalms
   D. Romans

10. Which is the last book of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Revelation
   B. Acts
   C. Malachi
   D. Jude

11. Which of these is kind treatment of a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving it hungry
   B. Beating it
   C. Overloading it
   D. Giving it food, water and rest

12. Who first told Pharaoh about Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. The cupbearer
   B. A magician
   C. Potiphar
   D. The baker

13. Who would come upon Mary so that she could conceive? (1 mark)
   A. The Holy Spirit
   B. An angel
   C. Joseph
   D. Elizabeth

14. To whom was Mary engaged to be married? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. David
   C. Zechariah
   D. Simeon

15. Whom did the angel say was expecting a child in old age? (1 mark)
   A. Ruth
   B. Hannah
   C. Sarah
   D. Elizabeth

16. What does "forerunner" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher of maths
   B. A king
   C. One who follows behind
   D. One who goes before to prepare

17. Where was Bartimaeus sitting when Jesus passed? (1 mark)
   A. In the temple
   B. By the roadside near Jericho
   C. At a market
   D. On a boat

18. How should people with contagious diseases be treated? (1 mark)
   A. With insults
   B. With care and respect
   C. By making fun of them
   D. With rejection

19. What does it mean to forgive? (1 mark)
   A. To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   B. To hide
   C. To forget your name
   D. To hit back

20. What did Jesus tell the man after telling the story of the Good Samaritan? (1 mark)
   A. Go and wait
   B. Go and count
   C. Go and rest
   D. Go and do likewise

21. What does the parable teach about every person? (1 mark)
   A. Only adults matter
   B. Only rich people matter
   C. Nobody matters
   D. Every person is precious to God

22. Why did Jesus tell the parables in Luke 15? (1 mark)
   A. Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   B. To entertain
   C. To praise money
   D. To teach farming

23. What did Nicodemus bring to prepare Jesus' body for burial? (1 mark)
   A. Oil only
   B. Myrrh and aloes
   C. Gold
   D. Bread

24. Who baptised Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. John the Baptist
   B. Paul
   C. Peter
   D. Stephen

25. Which of these shows a good response to John 3:16? (1 mark)
   A. Forgetting the verse
   B. Believing in Jesus and thanking God
   C. Ignoring God
   D. Blaming others

26. Which of these helps us to overcome lying? (1 mark)
   A. Exaggerating
   B. Admitting mistakes quickly
   C. Hiding things
   D. Blaming others

27. What should you do if an adult tells you to do something that hurts you? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   B. Obey
   C. Hide it
   D. Copy it

28. Which verse says that God is love? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. 1 John 4:8

29. Which is a way of keeping a uniform in good condition? (1 mark)
   A. Lending it out
   B. Tearing it
   C. Washing and mending it
   D. Leaving it in mud

30. Which helps you to avoid situations that lead to sin? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring parents
   B. Going to wrong places
   C. Choosing good friends
   D. Keeping bad secrets

31. Who ran away from a wrong situation and was wise? (1 mark)
   A. Zacchaeus
   B. Balaam
   C. Joseph
   D. Nicodemus

32. What does Psalm 122:1 say people were glad to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to the house of the Lord
   B. Go to sleep
   C. Go to market
   D. Go to war

33. What should we do with phones in church? (1 mark)
   A. Make calls
   B. Watch videos
   C. Switch them off or keep them silent
   D. Play games

34. What does persecution mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being paid
   B. Being treated badly because of what you believe
   C. Being taught
   D. Being praised

35. In Matthew 6:5-6, how did Jesus say we should pray? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Only in public
   C. Loudly to impress
   D. Sincerely, not to be seen by others

36. Which is a good habit in prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Praying only when scared
   B. Praying morning and evening
   C. Praying only in church
   D. Never praying

37. Which fruit is shown by keeping a promise? (1 mark)
   A. Selfishness
   B. Anger
   C. Envy
   D. Faithfulness

38. Who helps us to make right decisions? (1 mark)
   A. Strangers
   B. Bad friends
   C. Nobody
   D. The Holy Spirit

39. What does "keep in step with the Spirit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   B. Dance
   C. Walk in a line
   D. Run fast

40. Which verse compares a person without self-control to a broken city wall? (1 mark)
   A. Proverbs 1:7
   B. Proverbs 25:28
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. John 3:16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain what a child should do if they are offered drugs or asked to do something that defiles the body. (5 marks)

42. Give three reasons why children should not join ungodly groups. (3 marks)

43. Explain why we should thank God for making us. (3 marks)

44. Describe what Jesus did to raise the widow's son. (3 marks)

45. Describe three steps you can follow to forgive someone. (3 marks)

46. Name the four Gospels and say what they tell us about. (4 marks)

47. Explain how a child can show any five fruits of the Spirit in daily life. (5 marks)

48. Describe how the boy in John 6 shows that small gifts can do great things. (4 marks)

49. Give four benefits of forgiving others. (4 marks)

50. Explain what the story teaches about the power of Jesus and His care for people. (4 marks)

51. Why was the widow of Nain in great need? (2 marks)

52. State two things that the story of Jesus blessing children teaches. (2 marks)

53. Describe Joseph's plan to save Egypt from the famine. (4 marks)

54. Give three reasons why baptism is important to Christians. (3 marks)

55. Explain how the early church shows that God's kingdom grew from a small beginning. (5 marks)

56. Give three reasons why we should read the Bible. (3 marks)

57. Explain why God changed Abram's name to Abraham. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   All people are unique and special to God, so it is not a reason to boast.

2. A — Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   Sharing feelings with a trusted person and praying helps.

3. A — Helping her to carry water
   Helping shows respect and care.

4. D — At the top
   A family tree shows the oldest generation at the top.

5. D — You feel uneasy or scared
   Uneasy feelings are a signal to move away.

6. C — The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   1 Corinthians 6:19 gives this reason.

7. C — Pure, perfect and set apart
   God is holy because He never does wrong.

8. B — Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   We respect the Bible because it is God's word.

9. A — John
   The four Gospels are Matthew, Mark, Luke and John.

10. A — Revelation
   Revelation is the last book of the New Testament and of the Bible.

11. D — Giving it food, water and rest
   Kindness to animals includes meeting their needs.

12. A — The cupbearer
   The cupbearer remembered Joseph from prison.

13. A — The Holy Spirit
   Luke 1:35 says the Holy Spirit would come on her.

14. A — Joseph
   Mary was engaged to Joseph of the house of David.

15. D — Elizabeth
   Mary's relative Elizabeth was expecting a baby.

16. D — One who goes before to prepare
   A forerunner goes ahead.

17. B — By the roadside near Jericho
   Mark 10:46 says he was by the roadside.

18. B — With care and respect
   Jesus showed kindness to those with leprosy.

19. A — To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   Forgiving lets go of revenge.

20. D — Go and do likewise
   Luke 10:37 says, "Go and do likewise."

21. D — Every person is precious to God
   God searches for each person.

22. A — Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   Jesus showed God's love for sinners.

23. B — Myrrh and aloes
   John 19:39 says he brought myrrh and aloes.

24. A — John the Baptist
   Matthew 3:13-17 says John baptised Jesus.

25. B — Believing in Jesus and thanking God
   We respond with faith and thanks.

26. B — Admitting mistakes quickly
   Admitting mistakes builds truthfulness.

27. A — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Obedience is only for good instructions.

28. D — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

29. C — Washing and mending it
   Good care extends its life.

30. C — Choosing good friends
   Good friends help us do right.

31. C — Joseph
   Joseph ran from temptation.

32. A — Go to the house of the Lord
   The psalm rejoices at going to God's house.

33. C — Switch them off or keep them silent
   Phones can disturb worship.

34. B — Being treated badly because of what you believe
   Persecution is unfair treatment for faith.

35. D — Sincerely, not to be seen by others
   Jesus warned against showing off.

36. B — Praying morning and evening
   Regular prayer builds faith.

37. D — Faithfulness
   Faithfulness is loyalty.

38. D — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit guides believers.

39. A — Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   Galatians 5:25.

40. B — Proverbs 25:28
   Proverbs 25:28.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, walk away, avoid the group, tell a trusted adult such as a parent or teacher, pray for strength, and choose friends who make good choices.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying no, 1 for walking away, 1 for telling an adult, 1 for prayer, 1 for good friends.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: They lead to wrong; they can harm us; they pull us from God and family; they ask for secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: God created us in His image and planned each of us. He gave us life, family and talents. Thanking Him shows that we value His gifts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God creating us, 1 for the gifts of life or talents, 1 for the link to giving thanks.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: He felt compassion, told the woman not to cry, touched the bier and told the young man to get up.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for compassion, 1 for touching the bier, 1 for the command.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Calm down; think about what happened; talk to the person kindly; say I forgive you; pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. They tell about the life, teachings, death and resurrection of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each Gospel named up to 3 marks, and 1 mark for what they tell about.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing; joy: thanking God; peace: stopping quarrels; patience: waiting your turn; kindness: helping others; goodness: honesty; faithfulness: keeping promises; gentleness: speaking softly; self-control: walking away from a fight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with an example, up to 5.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy shared five loaves and two fish. Jesus used them to feed a large crowd. This shows that a small gift given willingly can help many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy sharing, 1 for the food, 1 for Jesus feeding many, 1 for the lesson.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: Peace, restored friendship, freedom from anger, pleasing God, fewer fights.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit up to 4.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over death. He cares for the poor and lonely, such as widows. He acts out of compassion. People recognised God at work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: She had lost her husband and now her only son, so she had nobody to provide for her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the husband and 1 for the son.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves children; children are important; they are welcome in God's kingdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: Find a wise man to be in charge, take a fifth of the grain during the seven good years, store it in the towns, and use it in the famine years.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: It shows a decision to follow Jesus; it is a sign of being washed from sin; it joins us to the church; Jesus taught it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

55. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus began with a few disciples. On Pentecost about three thousand believed and were baptised. The church spread to many towns and countries, and today it is found in all the world including Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the few disciples, 1 for Pentecost, 1 for three thousand, 1 for spreading, 1 for today's church.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: It teaches right from wrong, comforts us, helps us to know God, gives stories of people who followed God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: God made a covenant with him and promised that he would be a father of many nations. The new name reminded him of this promise.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the covenant, 1 for the promise, 1 for the name as a reminder.
